customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be of good quality and appreciate its performance, with one noting the new technology helps improve RO life. The installation process is hassle-free, and the water tastes great. They like its appearance, with one highlighting its premium matte finish, and find it easy to maintain. While the filter life receives mixed reviews, with some units breaking within days of purchase, customers express satisfaction with their overall experience.

reviews.author: Ravi Singh
reviews.title: Good Product at a reasonable price.
reviews.body: It’s a no-nonsense water purifier. You get RO + UV + a mineraliser, which is more than enough for most people. The installation was on time, and the technician was very good. If you’re looking for a fancy water purifier with all those gimmicky features, you might be disappointed with this one. But if you want a practical, reliable product, go for it.

reviews.author: SUMAN P.
reviews.title: I satisfied with this product
reviews.body: Buying to installation is very good experience. All parts is provided by company. No need to pay anything after purchasing.

reviews.author: Nikhil Shiv
reviews.title: Excellent Product and Service
reviews.body: Great product with excellent service. The water tastes much better, and the installation process was easy. Happy with my purchase and would recommend it.

reviews.author: Aishwarya Singh
reviews.title: A Good Product and A greater Service Experience
reviews.body: Using it for 3weeks no issue so far. installation process was seamless. I would recommend this water purifier for if nothing else then a great customer service experience like thats a novelty in india. also paying for a filter after 2 year is a huge plus and all consultation and maintenance service free for 2 years.
